description: Four core frames with AMODE 20, a user defined channel arrangement of two channels.

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's decoder rejects the arrangement, so ffprobe gets no sampling frequency or channels
skip.decode: ffmpeg supports the arrangements up to 15 only (dca.c, DCA_AMODE_COUNT)
skip.libdca: libdca does not decode user defined arrangements (its flags stop at DCA_CHANNEL_MAX).
